a1.name: Goethe-Zertifikat A1
a1.tagline: Your first Goethe certificate — everyday German basics.
a1.useCase: Family reunification, basic residence requirements, and proof of starter German.

a2.name: Goethe-Zertifikat A2
a2.tagline: Solid elementary German for work, travel, and daily life.
a2.useCase: Jobs requiring basic German, some visa pathways, and further study toward B1.

b1.name: Goethe-Zertifikat B1
b1.tagline: The standard intermediate exam — citizenship, work, and study.
b1.useCase: German citizenship, many employers, and Studienkolleg preparation.

b2.name: Goethe-Zertifikat B2
b2.tagline: Upper-intermediate proof for university and professional roles.
b2.useCase: University admission, regulated professions, and skilled migration.

c1.name: Goethe-Zertifikat C1
c1.tagline: Advanced German for academic and professional excellence.
c1.useCase: University study in German, advanced workplaces, and teaching pathways.

c2.name: Goethe-Zertifikat C2
c2.tagline: Near-native mastery — the highest Goethe certificate.
c2.useCase: Academic teaching, translation, and demonstrating near-native competence.
